description: This file is a shell script used for performance testing of git log commands with various patterns and options. It sources external library scripts and executes test functions to measure performance across different regex and pickaxe options.

methods.name: test_perf_default_repo
methods.description: Initializes or tests performance on the default repository for the perf tests.

methods.name: test_have_prereq
methods.description: Checks for the presence of required prerequisites, e.g., EXPENSIVE.

methods.name: test_perf
methods.description: Runs performance testing for a specified git log command with given parameters.

methods.name: test_done
methods.description: Marks the completion of the performance tests.
